voices.nap-18120216-531: @maret I beg that you will repeat my instructions to Marshal Marmont in the following terms
voices.nap-18120328-536: Inform Marshal Davoust that I do not suppose that the Russians will move
voices.nap-18120702-540: @maret I tell you this for your information, but you need not write anything about it
voices.nap-18120801-541: We have killed 3,000 or 4,000 of the enemy, wounded the triple, and found here a large number of guns
voices.nap-18120902-545: I set down the loss of the enemy at from 40,000 to 50,000 men
voices.nap-18120910-546: We have found an immense quantity of things in Moscow, which was a very beautiful city
voices.nap-18121010-548: @berthier Frenchmen at Moscow, I have abandoned to you my two houses
voices.nap-18121102-550: We took 6,000 prisoners, but we have to lament the loss of General Partouneaux's brigade, which, having missed its way, was captured
voices.nap-18121218-555: I have 100,000 stragglers who are trying to live, and who are no longer under the colours
voices.nap-18121218-556: I have just raised 15,000 cavalry and 8,000 artillery horses, in addition to 4,000 animals for the military train
voices.nap-18130101-557: Referred to Marshal Duroc to send for the inventor, to examine the musket with the officers of the artillery of the Guard, to have trials made, and to furnish me with a report.1 «
voices.nap-18130101-558: My Guard was never engaged, and did not lose a single man in action, and it could not therefore have lost any eagles as the Russians declare
voices.nap-18130101-559: I am very anxious to know if any Frenchmen have been left at Thorn
voices.nap-18130126-561: @eugene I have already told you to assemble an advanced guard of 40,000 men and 6,000 horses, in order to hold
voices.nap-18130301-567: @duroc I suppose that he had already reached that city when you left it
voices.nap-18130313-570: @bigot You must say that if the Pope ever becomes a temporal sovereign we shall break off relations with him
voices.nap-18130313-571: I approve of the measures taken for the defence of the Pyrenees, and for calling out the national guard
voices.nap-18130401-572: I am sorry for the affair of the bridge of Dresden (which had been blown up by Davoust), but that after all is only an affair of a few hundred thousand francs
voices.nap-18130401-573: @clarke I thank your Majesty for the information you have sent me concerning Torgau
voices.nap-18130402-574: Reply to the King of Spain that I gave him the command-in-chief of my army
voices.nap-18130413-575: @caulaincourt Prince Schwartzenberg has handed me your Majesty's letter
voices.nap-18130417-576: I shall remain here for several days to look after a great many things which are wanting
voices.nap-18130501-579: I have decided to die, if necessary, at the head of all that is generous in France, sooner than become the laughing-stock of the English, and to allow my enemies to triumph
voices.nap-18130503-580: @cambaceres I am sorry that you did not advise the Empress to pardon the man condemned to death
voices.nap-18130507-581: The Saxon General Gersdorf has just brought me a letter from the king, with an order placing Torgau and General Thielman at my disposal
voices.nap-18130512-583: @austria I hasten to inform your Majesty that my health is excellent, counting upon the interest you bear me
voices.nap-18130607-586: I see with pleasure that my son grows and continues to give hopes
voices.nap-18130608-587: @cambaceres You must also let them travel without fuss, and without making any embarras on the road
voices.nap-18130801-592: I hope to make Austria repent her foolish aspirations and her infamous treason
voices.nap-18130817-595: I shall have the heights of Pirna occupied by the Young Guard
voices.nap-18131031-602: We shall therefore have everything to fear without the energy and the power of the nation
voices.nap-18131110-603: Not that I have any reason to distrust the Swiss, but because in the present state of the Empire it is necessary to arm on all sides
voices.nap-18131110-604: @caulaincourt I beg that you will hasten to Naples to make the •king feel the necessity of marching on the Po with 25,000 men
voices.nap-18140110-609: @joseph I think that it will not be suitable for you to wear any foreign decorations
voices.nap-18140201-612: We have taken nearly all their artillery, all their baggage, and killed an enormous lot of men
voices.nap-18140201-613: I know not where all this will end, but it is sure our lot will never be fixed as long as it depends on the Emperor
voices.nap-18140206-617: In the event of anything unforeseen happening the idea of putting King Louis at the head of Paris seems to me a good one
voices.nap-18140302-626: I have seen with pleasure the conduct of the three ships
voices.nap-18140303-627: I fear that there be certain chiefs who do not wish to fight
voices.nap-18140323-634: A.M., the Emperor sent a despatch to Marshal Ney in which he said — Having learned that the Emperor Alexander slept at Montierender, I am going to St
voices.nap-18140818-638: I think there are things enough for Madame's kitchen and mine
voices.nap-18150301-643: The army and the people of country and of town came out to meet me
voices.nap-18150606-650: My ambition is to see France enjoy all the liberty possible
voices.nap-17960522-81: @directory You can at present count upon from 6,000,000 to 8,000,000 francs in gold or silver, ingots
voices.nap-17981001-81: @directory I send you my brother (Louis) with the standards taken from the Turks and Mamelukes
voices.nap-17990822-81: I take with me Berthier, Lannes, Murat, Andreossy, and Marmont, the citizens Monge and Berthollet
voices.nap-18020607-81: Take measures to prevent any vessel, no matter to what nation it belongs, being blockaded or captured in our waters
voices.nap-18070510-81: @josephine I can conceive all the grief which the death of the little Napoleon must cause you
voices.nap-18080301-81: All this leaves several matters, which are of great interest to my people, in obscurity
voices.nap-18100207-81: @remusat You furnish me with no report respecting the administration of the theatres, and you have new pieces rehearsed without informing me
voices.nap-18150609-81: The enthusiasm of the inhabitants of Charleroi and of all the country through which we pass is beyond description

tweets.nap-18051201-288: Yesterday I fought the decisive battle. 80,000 Russians and 30,000 Austrians stood against my smaller army — I took 40,000 prisoners, their cannon, their standards. Tonight I sleep in Kaunitz's castle, in a clean shirt for the first time in eight days.
tweets.nap-18051201-289: Dolgorouki came to my outposts oozing arrogance — mistook my moderation for fear. That error gave me Austerlitz. Now the Tsar has opened his eyes and wants peace, never to meddle again.
tweets.nap-18051201-290: We have taken forty-five flags. On this anniversary of my coronation — the day the Holy father and all 87 clergy of France prayed for my reign at Notre Dame — I will hang them in the church. Paris shall see them.
tweets.nap-18051201-291: Davout — send me a detailed, truthful account of Austerlitz. Tell me plainly what happened, and whether Klein's division did anything.
tweets.nap-18051201-48: Eugène — I have arranged your marriage with Princess Augusta of Bavaria. The banns are published; she visited me this morning, and she is even lovelier than her portrait.
tweets.nap-18051201-47: Berthier — a million in paper is at your disposal. Bring me a plan for distributing two millions among my marshals, generals and colonels.
tweets.nap-18060201-306: I can make nothing of this Parma business. Send Eugène's troops, burn five or six villages, shoot sixty men — make examples so severe Italy learns its lesson. And where is Menou in all this?
tweets.nap-18060201-307: 200,000 Prussians threaten — they are mad; tell Haugwitz this finishes. The prince of the peace has paid his 11,000,000 francs, and I will back him in Portugal by force of arms. Adventurers lie about Ireland; my eyes are on the navy until England makes peace.
tweets.nap-18060201-308: Your prosperity, and especially your glory, is everything in your position — without it life has no charm. I hope Mathieu Dumas has joined you.
tweets.nap-18060201-309: My cousin of Austria may remove the arms from his Tyrol castle — but see that François I's armour, and anything curious, is kept for me. I attach importance to it.
tweets.nap-18060201-310: I have your letter. Tell me: have you taken the Farnese and Venice palaces in my name? And what am I to do with them?
tweets.nap-18060201-311: Joseph — first task in Naples: let every man stay in office, disarm the country, set a good police minister, drive out foreigners, seize English goods. And read me your army returns — no books please me more.
tweets.nap-18060201-312: You cannot want money. Disarm Naples, take 10,000,000 francs from the city — it will pay easily. Confiscate English merchandise; your resources are certain. And occupy the forts, for all the St. Januarius celebrating.
tweets.nap-18150226-641: I am leaving Elba. I leave my mother and sister in your care — no greater mark of confidence. Guard this island I love; you have my affection and my protection.
tweets.nap-18210415-01: I die before my time, murdered by the English oligarchy and its hired killer. The English people will avenge me.
tweets.nap-18210415-02: Let my ashes rest on the banks of the Seine, among the French people I loved so well.
tweets.nap-17960501-08: We reached Acqui yesterday, but Beaulieu flies too fast to catch. Send me notes on everything around Genoa — the imperial fiefs, and the Dukes of Parma, Piacenza and Modena with the forces each has in the field.
tweets.nap-17960501-09: I have your answer. Convey the army thanks to the Corps Législatif for its decree — no recompense touches soldiers more. As for me, my devotion to the constitution has never wavered; I saw it born amid passions trying to destroy the Republic.
tweets.nap-17960501-11: My army of Italy is in the greatest distress. Every day brings recruits I cannot feed, while the Directory plan demands offensive warfare with prompt measures and extraordinary resources — yet even two sous to the men and eight francs to the officers goes unpaid.
tweets.nap-17960501-17: We have crossed the Po — the second campaign opens. Beaulieu miscalculates and walks into my snares; he has audacity and energy but no genius. 6,000 of his men beaten back across the Adda yesterday, and one more victory makes Italy ours.
tweets.nap-17960501-18: People of Milan — my army is generous as it is strong. It will treat peaceful inhabitants as brothers, and fall like the fire of heaven upon rebels.
tweets.nap-18070201-05: Your Mayence letter made me smile. I am 120 miles from Warsaw this morning — cold but fine weather. Adieu, my love; be happy, and have character.
tweets.nap-18070201-190: Let there be an end to your family misfortunes, and let the Prussian monarchy be organized — Europe needs its middle power. I desire peace with Russia too, if her cabinet drops its designs on Turkey.
tweets.nap-18070201-92: Our affairs could not go better. 20,000 men cut off, the Russian army flying in disorder, guns and magazines falling into our hands. My only fear: that the trapped corps proves Prussian.
tweets.nap-18070201-95: My brother — I send you my aide-de-camp Bertrand, who holds my entire confidence. What he carries, I hope, will please you; believe this the start of a durable friendship between us.
tweets.nap-18070201-369: It is 2 in the morning and I am spent, so a few words. Duroc will tell you: we beat the Russians yesterday. Accept the overtures; I will send plenipotentiaries to Memel the moment Russia or Prussia names theirs.
tweets.nap-18070201-370: My cousin — the weather has turned severe. I fought yesterday and won, but at great cost in men. The bulletin has the details, and it is exact.
tweets.nap-18070201-372: My friend — I am still at Eylau, and the ground is covered with dead and wounded. This is war at its ugliest, and my heart is heavy. I am well; we repulsed the enemy and broke his plans. Rest easy, and tell Caroline and Pauline that Murat and Borghese are safe.
tweets.nap-18050810-276: Decide now. Austria stalls with fine phrases to gain time and stop me achieving anything this year — her subsidy treaty signed, I shall find 100,000 Russians in Poland, 20,000 English at Malta, 15,000 Russians at Corfu. My mind is made up.
tweets.nap-18050810-277: I decree horse races across the Empire, starting with the great breeding departments; prizes for the fleetest. The Orne, Correze, Seine, Morbihan, Sarre and Hautes-Pyrenees run yearly. I will improve the French horse.
tweets.nap-18050810-35: The Library answers to the interior minister, and I have placed 200,000 francs at his disposal — yet the treasury refuses to pay. David gets his sums, my librarian his engravings; the Gobelins and Sèvres must work without costing the treasury.
tweets.nap-18050810-36: My sister — the grand marshal sends my portrait for the people of Lucca, as you asked. Now send me a full account of your coasts with the batteries needed. I will send the guns.
tweets.nap-18050810-37: My armies admit no transaction smelling of weakness. Giving Hanover to Prussia augments her by 40,000 men and improves her states — in return she guarantees my Italy and Tuscany, and my Rhine frontier stands.
tweets.nap-18070301-101: That brigand Schill is cut off from Kolberg and fallen back. Send Saxon or Polish cavalry after the wretch — that is my order.
tweets.nap-18070301-379: Let Andreossy tell them plainly: besides 140,000 men in my depots, I have raised 80,000 conscripts and ten reserve legions. France is not empty.
tweets.nap-18070301-380: Your letter grieves me — you are well, so put away thoughts of dying. But you must not go running about inns and camps this summer. I want to see you and live quietly; I know things besides war, but duty comes first. All my life I have sacrificed everything to destiny.
tweets.nap-18070301-98: Since the Porte will have no troops at Constantinople or in Bosnia, tell the ambassador it is settled. As for the officers requested — I need numbers, ranks, branches.
tweets.nap-18070301-99: Your letter is here. The English squadron lies off Constantinople, their ambassador gone — we shall see how this ends.
tweets.nap-17961002-14: Sire — all Europe desires peace, and I tell you plainly: this disastrous war has lasted too long.
tweets.nap-17961002-36: Venice plots with Naples and the Pope while every Italian hates us. Naples has raised 60,000 men — dethroning him costs me 18,000 foot and 3,000 horse. Rome burns with fanaticism; if she declares, I guard my rear and hold her with 6,000 men.
tweets.nap-17961002-37: For the Corsican amnesty, except these men: the four deputies who carried the crown to London, the Viceroy's six councillors, and the émigrés. Panatieri — Paoli's secretary, come from London to intrigue — I have had arrested at Leghorn.
tweets.nap-17960503-25: Laharpe — cross the Scrivia at once with all you have and enter Tortona.
tweets.nap-17960503-26: I need fifteen thousand bread rations from Novi — send fifty chasseurs at once.
tweets.nap-17960503-27: Pelletier — march half your troops to Serravalle at once.
tweets.nap-17960503-28: Masséna — seize every Bassignana boat for me and hold the right bank.
tweets.nap-17960503-29: Your letter received, sir, with thanks for the obliging intelligence.
tweets.nap-17980609-49: Brueys — I want the Civita-Vecchia convoy before Malta port.
tweets.nap-17980609-50: Desaix — reconnoitre Malta coast tonight by galley for me.
tweets.nap-17980609-51: Malta falls tonight — execute your orders punctually, every man.
tweets.nap-17980609-52: Duprat has my orders to feed your division meanwhile.
tweets.nap-17980609-53: Vaubois — land at 2 in the morning, wherever you find coast.
tweets.nap-18060101-297: Despatch your brother Berthier with the decree making Joseph commander in Naples. He stays at headquarters in total secrecy — I am not sure Joseph will accept, so nothing must be known.
tweets.nap-18060101-298: Your letter grieved me deeply — while every Power in England pay leagues against me in an unjust war, you listened to bad counsels. Keep my minister or send him away, as you wish. But Ancona I hold: your fortress undefended, and better in my hands than the English.
tweets.nap-18060101-299: The Pope writes me letters both ridiculous and insane. I took Ancona because nothing was done for its defence — no bantering, no Russian ministers at Rome. I will replace you with a secular ambassador, even a Protestant one.
tweets.nap-18060101-301: Your reflections on Rufifo are mean and puerile — you behave like a woman at Rome, meddling in what you do not understand. Take possession of the Venetian palace; I have written Joseph to aid you by force if need be.
tweets.nap-18060101-51: My son — I arrived yesterday evening and leave again tomorrow. I send you the Moniteur with matters concerning yourself inside.
tweets.nap-18060910-342: I see no reason to refuse Ney twenty days for his wife's confinement — grant Davout the same on the same terms. And in a few days I will grant you leave too; I know you wish for Paris.
tweets.nap-18060910-344: Fox is dying, and all England with him is in consternation — Yarmouth is cheered in London only as a man of peace. I have just heard Fox is dead: a man regretted by two nations. Now read my despatches on the coming war.
tweets.nap-18060910-72: I was sending you homeward orders when word came: Russia refuses to ratify. So we wait some days and watch. Send Polish officers to the Russian frontier to see what moves.
tweets.nap-18060910-74: You have heard of Prussia armaments and Russia non-ratification. My talks with England continue, but their pretensions are wild — Surinam, Berbice, all your colonies.
tweets.nap-18070101-189: Soldiers — it is a year to this very hour since you stood at Austerlitz, where Russian battalions fled or stacked their arms. Next day they talked peace, but it was a trick.
tweets.nap-18070101-361: These are my returns from a short campaign: 420,000 in hospital, 210,000 fever cases, 100,000 wounded, 32,000 dead.
tweets.nap-18070101-362: My brother — I congratulate myself on the peace between us, which time will only strengthen. Our allies are the same, your interests are mine, and our union stands on confidence and esteem.
tweets.nap-18070101-89: My cousin — spare Mecklenburg-Strelitz. An old grandmother of Princess Eugène lives there; see she wants for nothing, and tell her you are ordered to treat her with particular attention.
tweets.nap-18070101-90: The Place de la Concorde keeps its name — Concorde is what makes my France invincible.
tweets.nap-17950701-01: Still no letter — a month since you left. Louis studies mathematics at Châlons; Junot lives large on his father money. I wait your word before buying property — nothing suitable under 800,000 francs. Embrace your wife for me in Paris, where one lives freer than Genoa.
tweets.nap-17950712-02: I report good news on every front: the English re-embark, Pichegru crosses the Rhine, the Vendée is quiet, Spain nears peace. And Paris drowns in pleasure — opera crowds at triple prices, fashion back as if the Terror were a dream.
tweets.nap-17950817-03: I refuse the Vendée — others command brigades better than I, but none serves guns like me. Let the injustice sting those who understand service. Health, constancy, never discouraged.
tweets.nap-17950901-04: The Royalists stir — we shall see. Schérer goes to Italy, Kellermann to the Alps, Hoche to Vendée. The Committee keeps me in guns, likely at Paris — and I may be seized with the madness of marrying. Speak to Désirée brother for me.
tweets.nap-17950906-05: Fear nothing for me — I have friends in every party. Louis answers all my hopes: warmth, wit, talent, honesty, all combined. I live only for my family pleasure; keep luck with me and I shall fulfill all your desires.
tweets.nap-17960301-06: I have asked Barras to tell the Directory of my marriage to Citoyenne Tascher Beauharnais. It binds me closer to the country — a pledge that I seek salvation in the Republic alone.
tweets.nap-17960301-07: I have taken command. The administration is bad but not hopeless — I threaten the thieving contractors, then flatter them, and the army gets bread, meat and arrears. Tell the Directors their orders will be carried out; I march shortly.
tweets.nap-17960327-08: Your letter is here — I dined with Schérer and your wife yesterday, and I shall gladly serve her. Take the Genoese 3,000,000 francs quietly, and keep their friendship; their enmity would ruin our trade and my campaign.
tweets.nap-17960401-09: Enclosed: General Colli letter with my answer, which I hope suits you. The treasury bills bounce — one for 172,800 francs drawn on Cadiz just came back. I found this army destitute and mutinous, singing for the Dauphin; two officers face court martial.
tweets.nap-17960401-10: Montenotte and Millesimo are in my report — but I am seconded by neither guns nor engineers; despite your orders I have not one officer I asked for. I took Montezemolo myself and must survey Ceva in person while Beaulieu rages.
tweets.nap-17960401-11: Mondovi does the troops the greatest honour. But you have no idea of this army state — undermined, breadless, undisciplined when I came. I work all night, I make examples; the breadless soldier shames us all. The enemy is strong and fights well.
tweets.nap-17960402-12: It pained me to hear our troops surprised at St. Michel. But these movements put you in place for a brilliant revenge — this little check is only the prelude to our victory.
tweets.nap-17960406-13: I have moved headquarters to Albenga. The stir against Genoa annoys me — it forces that Republic hostile, wakes the enemy I meant to catch napping, and will cost us men. Colli sent an envoy under truce; I arrested him and ordered court martial — nothing shields a parricide.
tweets.nap-17960414-14: The campaign opens — my Montenotte report is enclosed. Beaulieu came with 10,000 men; Cervoni held with free soldiers courage. I saw his true aim at once, and ordered Cervoni to slip away by night march to my centre.
tweets.nap-17960426-15: The first thirst is quenched — less pillaging now. Three shot, more to hard labour, and church thieves die tomorrow. In three days this army will be disciplined, and Italy will admire our moderation as it admires our courage. It pains me deeply.
tweets.nap-17960504-19: I march soon for Leghorn and Rome. I have written the Directory about dividing the army — I swear only the country interest moves me. If intriguers poison your mind, speak for me; Kellermann commands as well as I could.
tweets.nap-17960520-20: Soldiers — you dashed like a torrent from the Apennines and scattered all before you. Piedmont is free, Milan is ours, the flag flies over Lombardy. But no Capua for us: forced marches still, enemies still — keep moving.
tweets.nap-17960529-22: I come to free Italy from Austria iron yoke, not to conquer Venice — our friendship stands. Your religion, government, customs and property are safe; all we take is paid in money. But enemies of liberty will find the French soldier terrible.
tweets.nap-17960601-23: The Austrians are swept from Italy; my advanced posts stand on Germany mountains. My grenadiers laugh with death and sing of love and country on forced marches — ask them their plans and every man has one.
tweets.nap-17960602-24: I have reached Verona, a great fine city, and garrisoned its three Adige bridges. Let it be known: had the so-called king evacuated before I crossed the Po, I would have burned the place. I have seen the amphitheatre — Rome shames our Champ de Mars.
tweets.nap-17960621-25: Augereau crossed the Po yesterday and took Bologna, with 400 of the Pope soldiers prisoners. The Cardinal Legate, his staff, four flags — I claim them all.
tweets.nap-17960621-26: My military position you know; now politics. The captive Legate goes to Rome on parole: let the Pope repair Basseville murder and pay for this war, or find refuge in the Republic. I have freed Bologna senate to annul every decree against its liberty.
tweets.nap-17960626-27: Azara haggled like a horse-trader: offered 5 millions cash and 3 in goods against my 40. Then he wormed our secret from my commissioners — that we cannot march on Rome — and suddenly 20 millions is the ceiling. Even Lorette treasure slipped to one.
tweets.nap-17960706-28: Corsica rises against the English — I have sent guns, powder and twenty refugees, and we are masters of Leghorn. No soldiers needed: more guns, Salicetti, decent pamphlets and a general pardon will drive them out.
tweets.nap-17960802-30: Fortune frowns for the moment — no time for details. Lonato is won and my measures are vigorous; I have raised the Mantua siege with nearly all my forces. I have ridden five horses to death and cannot write the Directory.
tweets.nap-17960809-31: My brother the war commissary has run to Paris without leave, meddling in politics as always — order him to some army. Young Louis deserves your favor — he served me at Lonato.
tweets.nap-17960914-32: Brave Tyrolians — I enter to force Vienna into a peace Europe needs, and your cause is mine. Your religion and customs are safe. But take arms against your own interests, and we shall be terrible as heaven fire — burned houses, wasted villages.
tweets.nap-17960926-33: Your character, praised by all who know you, moves me to let you return to Ferrara, veiling last month in oblivion. You know the Testament too well for it to be more than forgetfulness — but priests in politics earn no respect. Return to your diocese.
tweets.nap-17961001-34: After St. George I tried to draw Wurmser out and weaken Mantua. I hold 18,900 watching and 9,000 besieging — but to winter in Italy I need 35,000 in the field and 18,000 at the siege: 53,000 against my 27,000. Send me everything.
tweets.nap-17961001-35: Rome refuses peace, breaks the armistice, arms — she wants war and shall have it. But first one last effort: go to Rome, open the Pope eyes to his interests. He knows my strength; only my will stands between his temporal power and ruin.
tweets.nap-17961025-38: You have seen Lucien exalted letter. He compromised himself repeatedly despite my warnings, playing Jacobin; Marseilles is dangerous for him and the public. Corsica is free — send him there, for his hot head cannot stay with the Rhine army.
tweets.nap-17961027-39: Sire — Europe desires peace; this disastrous war has lasted too long. Send plenipotentiaries to Paris, or I fill Trieste harbor and ruin your Adriatic houses. I have held back only to spare the innocent.
tweets.nap-17961101-40: We are done with Corsica — greedy and jealous, its people are ruled only by shooting enemies and bribing friends. They already miss our silver.
tweets.nap-17961101-41: Vaubois panicked, losing 1,300 prisoners and guns, with a check at Caldiero — and so many brave dead make me circumspect. I no longer dare risk myself; my death would break the army. In a few days, one last effort.
tweets.nap-17961119-42: Arcole has decided Italy, and I am spent with fatigue — I cannot recount the movements. The bridge was desperate: Verdier, Bon, Verne, Lannes all down in the attempt. When Augereau flag failed to move them, I went myself and asked: are you the conquerors of Lodi?
tweets.nap-17961201-43: Hercules rode round the Austrians with twenty-five trumpeters and blew such a blast as has not sounded since Jericho. That stratagem decided the day — and I made him captain, with seventy-two francs to each guide.
tweets.nap-17961201-44: Your returns are full of errors. Italy proper had 38,500 foot, plus 10,000 — 51,100 without losses. Deduct 4,000 killed, wounded unfit, 2,000 dead in hospital: 7,000 gone. Only 12,500 reinforcements in a campaign of so many battles.
tweets.nap-17970101-45: Theft, not war, bleeds this army. The controller swindles, his clerks are incapable, everything is sold — we consume five times needful on false orders shared with contractors, while generals keep actresses. Laws fail; only a special court will do.
tweets.nap-17970102-46: Bring Bockty, Chevilly and Descrivains before my court-martial — they robbed and endangered the army, and comrades died for it. I demand death, to terrify their many accomplices.
tweets.nap-17970102-47: I had barely left Roverbella when Verona was attacked — Massena plans took 600 prisoners and three guns, and Brune caught seven bullets without a scratch. Alvinzi strikes everywhere at once to blind me about Mantua.
tweets.nap-17970107-48: I will not suffer seduction and revolt to bring war horrors. Advance on Castelnovo, shoot the rebel chief, send twenty hostages to Milan. Raze the confessor house and raise a pyramid there: punishment of a priest who preached revolt and murder.
tweets.nap-17970110-49: Enclosed: intercepted letters proving Rome obstinacy — even Vienna refuses the Pope alliance, wanting peace. I print them in Bologna gazettes for all Italy to judge. Tomorrow I cross the Po at Ferrara, bound for Rome.
tweets.nap-17970122-50: Foreign intriguers ruin Rome; my words of peace are stifled by men sold to their employers. This comedy nears its end, but my letters prove their perfidy. Assure His Holiness he may rest in Rome without fear, under my protection.
tweets.nap-17970201-51: My savants have reaped Ravenna, Rimini, Pesaro, Ancona, Loretto and Perugia — all forwarded to Paris at once. With what Rome must send, I now hold everything beautiful in Italy, save a few pieces at Turin and Naples.
tweets.nap-17970202-52: I recognize your simplicity, and name my only terms. Keep them, and His Holiness may yet save His States by trusting the Republic generosity. I know he was deceived — I grant five days for a negotiator at Foligno, where I hope to settle this myself.
tweets.nap-17970207-53: Read Faipoult memorandum and shudder at how the Republic is robbed. I have ordered the treasury controller and the commissary arrested, and Genoa to seize Payan and Pergallo. Flachat fled Milan with five millions.
tweets.nap-17970207-54: I direct my Minister: Send Paris the Mantua flags Augereau took — they close the campaign. While Rome comes to reason, I prepare the next one.
tweets.nap-17970302-55: People of Lienz — be tranquil, without fear. I will protect your religion, persons, properties, and your customs. And to Charles: prove yourself mankind benefactor, end this war — save one life and I prize that civic crown above all military glory.
tweets.nap-17970321-56: Boudet shall bear the colours — the terrible regiment nothing can stop. Our enemies are driven into the snowy Noric Alps, cavalry charging over ice. But my Rhine armies must enter Germany.
tweets.nap-17970412-57: You ask guarantees for your independence — are my daily victories not assurances? Each one is a line in your charter. Facts replace declarations.
tweets.nap-17970501-58: Peace talks open within days — you cannot go to Paris before that, and I shall not quit the army. After the signature, England or Portugal: an expedition sails, and you shall choose which.
tweets.nap-17970502-59: I am organizing the Cisalpine Republic, and its millions march: one for Toulon tomorrow, another for Paris the day after, one for Brest — 7,000,000 francs in all, down to Corsica share.
tweets.nap-17970502-60: Enclosed is Baraguey order. If you can get 3 or 4 millions, carry out the confiscation — gently, with least discontent to the Venetians. And squeeze Modena 6 millions, ready to seize on the inhabitants demand.
tweets.nap-17970502-61: I am informed forty-five Vicentin parishes refuse their church plate. Take measures — make them furnish like the rest.
tweets.nap-17970514-62: I enclose the Emperor ratification — plenipotentiaries quibbling over parchment and seal sizes. Our plan tabled today: France to the Rhine, Salzburg and Passau to him, Cleves to Prussia, Venice to him, guarantees all round.
tweets.nap-17970520-63: We have taken Venice — anarchy, civil war, and our welcome by the people. England and Russia ambassadors have fled with dAntrigues. Send me instructions on Rome: the Pope is dying, and all English, Russian and Portuguese goods in Venice are confiscated.
tweets.nap-17970521-64: I approve the St. Nicholas sale if paid in four months. Get 500,000 down for St. Martin, and a million to André. If the English-goods confiscation breeds too much hate for under 4 millions, drop it — treat Venetians generously, not as Ancona was treated.
tweets.nap-17970601-65: I fear the Josephus is lost — the only papyrus manuscript in existence, sent from Milan to Paris and never arrived. Inform me whether it reached the National Library.
tweets.nap-17970601-66: I meant Kilmaine for Marseilles, but he begs to join the England expedition if it sails.
tweets.nap-17970601-67: I have made young Eugène de Beauharnais sub-lieutenant of hussars and my aide-de-camp. Confirm it — he is a brave officer son, and the country will long mourn His Father.
tweets.nap-17970602-68: The Pope lies dying of apoplexy — send me positive instructions for his death. A new Pope? Revolution in Rome? The king of Italy marching? Must I oppose him?
tweets.nap-17970606-69: I have ordered two millions in gold and silver to Paris for Brest fortifications. Since the new campaign opened, Italy has fed the Rhine, the Sambre-et-Meuse and the Alps — argent everywhere.
tweets.nap-17970701-70: I send you Clarke letter — negotiations drag while the Emperor watches France. Paris sends eighty journals full of insults no one denies; my Soldiers ask whether six years of blood earns them assassination.
tweets.nap-17970701-71: I forward Clarke news — no trifling from Vienna. Reinforce me and I promise Vienna by harvest, where we drink Tokay with the Rhine army. Corfu welcomed us; Albania remembers Sparta. Greece may rise — and gallant Desaix is here to see Italy.
tweets.nap-17970726-72: Your letter is here, and your music is being copied across Italy. I shall enrich the conservatory myself — for of all fine arts, music moves the passions most.
tweets.nap-17970727-73: Grant Augereau leave for Paris — his private affairs call him. I send the army addresses with him.
tweets.nap-17970728-74: I enclose Joubert and Masséna addresses — the army is devoted. But Dumolard gossip, printed by the Assembly order, wounds them: they resent doubt cast on the massacres they suffered. I spend myself restraining their ardour.
tweets.nap-17970801-75: They tried to breed quarrels between you and the Republic — but I know your conduct throughout this war, and the Directory is satisfied. It will mark its regard at every chance.
tweets.nap-17970822-76: I enclose the Pope reply: let him order his bishops to preach obedience, if you wish it. Rome seethes — porters tell the Pope they want no blessings, only fewer taxes. Ratify Sardinia treaty for her 10,000 men.
tweets.nap-17970910-77: I have just received your pastoral letter — it reads like an apostle. You convert even unbelievers. But the haggard priests who preach revolt and murder for rich men gold, betraying like Judas — drive them out with the Church curses.
tweets.nap-17970913-78: My maxim henceforth: never abandon Corfu and Zante — hold them fast, for their trade will feed our future in these seas. And why not Malta? Brueys could anchor there: four hundred starving knights and one regiment against 100,000 people who favor us.
tweets.nap-17971006-79: Talks nearly broken — Austria demands too much. Send me money at once, dip into every coffer; I must have a million from the Brescians. Tell them and the Cisalpines: no money, and I make peace without them.
tweets.nap-17971007-80: Read Cobenzl scheme and share my indignation. Two or three days decide everything. I want peace; the season is late. But know these people: liberty will not make cowards great, and you ask miracles I do not know.
tweets.nap-17971101-81: My plan: 25,000 men stay in Italy, 36,000 sail for England, the rest to Nice, Chambéry and Corsica.
tweets.nap-17971101-82: Ratifications exchanged; the Congress fills — Sweden sends Fersen dripping with courtier fatuity. Explain this to me: how does a court that would reject a rebel-rouser send us ministers odious to every Frenchman?
tweets.nap-17971112-83: Here is my Army of Italy reorganized as the Army of England. Andreossy goes to Paris to cast guns to English calibre; we will fire their own balls back. Poussielgue sails for Malta, ostensibly for the Levant.
tweets.nap-17971114-84: Soldiers — I leave for Rastadt tomorrow, consoled only by soon sharing new dangers with you. Tell of conquered princes, freed nations, battles fought — say that in two campaigns we would have done more.
tweets.nap-17971114-85: I Send Clarke to Paris — months in Italy, and every intercepted letter of his is clean republicanism. His Carnot ties make diplomats nervous, but give him soldiers work, England work. Indulge him for me.
tweets.nap-17980201-86: I tour the ocean coasts tomorrow, back in twelve days. Desaix to Brest, Kléber to Havre — place 30,000 francs at Desaix disposal for the army of England extras.
tweets.nap-17980310-87: Your Genoa embarkation letters are here. Brune beat the Swiss and took thirty colours. Here are Surrurier and Cervoni commissions for the army of England.
tweets.nap-17980414-88: I want two things: the Directory letter for Monge to sail with Desaix, and Piveron with me — he served Tippoo once, and may reopen India to us.
tweets.nap-17980414-89: Your letters are here, general, and my confidence entire. I embark the first decade of Floréal — have a good bed ready, for I shall be sick the whole voyage. Tell no one of Toulon; you alone know.
tweets.nap-17980422-90: I need you started tomorrow at 4 with Fister, my wife chambermaid, and Hébert on the box. Take Lyons by Auxonne and Châlons — check my grooms and baggage reached town, and sleep at the Old Palais royal if it stands.
tweets.nap-17980501-91: Write me by this courier with every newspaper since I sailed. My couriers will stop at your house — see Moustache and Lesimple rejoin me at Toulon without delay.
tweets.nap-17980523-92: We have had good and bad weather, well at sea for Elba — past Bastia tonight, and I am not seasick. Send me all the news.
tweets.nap-17980601-93: I enclose Malta treaty with Russia, ratified five days ago — yet the Tsar should thank us: holding Malta saves His Treasury 400,000 roubles. We now own Europe strongest fortress, and dislodging us will cost dear.
tweets.nap-17980613-94: Send Monge and Berthollet to the Mint and St. John treasury for me — every precious object.
tweets.nap-17980702-95: I grieve the violence Ibrahim did you — if you are your own master, return to Cairo with a Sultan representative honours. The Mamelukes are destroyed; my Victorious arms stay at the Sultan disposal.
tweets.nap-17980721-96: I want Cairo fine mint fed — call in all the ingots left at Alexandria and give the merchants corn and rice, of which we have mountains. We have driven 2,000 of their best Mameluke horse into the Nile.
tweets.nap-17980731-97: I need you back at Rosetta for some days — that province needs you. Turks respect only severity: I take five or six heads daily in Cairo streets. Till now we spared the people to erase our fearsome name; now we must be obeyed — and to obey is to fear.
tweets.nap-17980801-98: The Justice reached me from Malta -- fortune, will you abandon me? Five days only!
tweets.nap-17980802-99: Remember Toulon — the English are nothing by land. Red-hot balls served coolly are terrible against ships. Go see Sheik El Messiri for me; tell him of our prophet feast, my conferences with the doctors, and that none believes more than I in Mohammed sanctity.
tweets.nap-17980901-100: I tell you plainly: by Egypt you may make what terms you will with England. Mistress of Egypt, France becomes in time mistress of India.
tweets.nap-17980901-101: Du Chayla cowardice with the English since his capture kills him in my eyes. There are men with no blood in their veins. I despise such conduct.
tweets.nap-17981006-102: Send Manscourt Mameluke merchants to Cairo for me and inquire into their advances. Seize Hassan-Allah property to repay the 40,000 medins he owes Koraim — but spare his brother, accused of nothing yet.
tweets.nap-17981017-103: Catch me Abdallah, Mourad steward, three days toward Alexandria — 1,000 crowns for him, not his worth but the example. He boarded the English Admiral ship; the Arabs would do much for 1,000 sequins.
tweets.nap-17981101-104: I abolish the bastinado for men holding secrets — torture produces nothing but whatever pops into wretches heads. It offends humanity and reason alike.
tweets.nap-17981202-105: I want Deriot marching at 2 with twenty-five troopers to Fort Sulkowski, gathering the thirty garrison men, Entering El Matarzeh before dawn. The Nile will be watched, and another ambush set.
tweets.nap-17981207-106: For our losses on her diamonds, I fine Mourad Bey wife 8,000 talari, due in five days.
tweets.nap-17981221-107: Perverse men led you astray, and they have perished. God commands me clement and merciful — I was angry at your revolt, I took your divan for two months, and today I restore it. Your conduct has washed the stain.
tweets.nap-17990101-108: I order it: threaten the Sheik of Myt-Ma sarah with the bastinado till he gives up the hidden Mamelukes and guns — then take his head and mount it with its inscription. That is my order.
tweets.nap-17990109-109: You may send the English a parlementaire — tell them their plague ship shall have every humane assistance. Send one upright, close-eared captain with our gazettes to trade for theirs, alone and without gossip.
tweets.nap-17990126-110: I want the sheep detachment officers and men arrested — Murat captured flock was pillaged by its own guards first. Stop the stolen sheep value from their pay.
tweets.nap-17990201-111: Several generals plead health and sail for France. A vessel brings my first European news in eight months — Genoa and Ancona letters. Now I can shape my course by the Continent.
tweets.nap-17990210-112: Desaix digs among Thebes ruins 160 leagues out — by the first courier I send you the Suez levels, perfectly preserved. I am building a corvette at Suez with four despatch boats in the Red sea.
tweets.nap-17990301-113: I send you our Hayfa prisoners under cartel — now return mine, especially from the last ships, on condition they Don serve against us.
tweets.nap-17990313-115: Djezzar beheaded my envoy and tortures our men — so El Arysch fell, Gaza fell with Samson fury, Jaffa stormed and twenty-four hours of horrors I never wish to see again. 4,000 of his troops slaughtered; Palestine is Republican.
tweets.nap-17990701-117: Eighty English sail off Alexandria, bound for Aboukir to land. When they are ashore I attack — death to those who refuse, chains and a fine Cairo spectacle to those who yield. Russians ride with them, hoping for Arab revolts.
tweets.nap-17990801-118: I was ill-pleased, Citizen general, with your late movements. Nothing excuses a soldier who disobeys — talent is overcoming obstacles, not citing them. Take this for your future guidance.
tweets.nap-17991001-120: Your Laplace Mécanique honors me — my first free six months go to reading it. Dine with me tomorrow, and bring Madame my respects.
tweets.nap-17991010-121: One despatch reached me before Acre — Naples wins, so a Continental war brews, and France needs me home. Egypt is safe from invasion and entirely ours. I sailed the Muiron through danger because my presence decides.
tweets.nap-17991202-122: Eighteen months gone, I return to find France at war with you. My nation has made me its head. Glory means nothing to me beside stopping the blood — our two characters can reconcile two nations.
tweets.nap-17991207-123: I have despatched ships to Egypt and hope they reached you. A staff officer follows with all the news — you will see it was high time I came home. These events should hearten our troops. I never lose sight of you.
tweets.nap-17991209-124: We have your letter, which justifies nothing. Courage preserves states; cowardice ruins them. You violated hospitality — not even desert hordes do that. Your two victims die illustrious, and their blood damns you more than an army.
tweets.nap-18000201-125: I am glad to see order restored in your army. Holland million and a half comes to you; Vendée is nearly pacified, and Brune has beaten little Georges.
tweets.nap-18000301-126: Minister — have Lebrun and Rouget write me a battle hymn to a known tune, Marseillaise or Chant du Départ. It must sing of every circumstance of war, and that peace marches behind victory.
tweets.nap-18000301-127: I have seen Georges — a sturdy Breton we may yet turn to the country account — and Chatillon dined with me today. I am well satisfied with both; and the Emperor treats us with utmost politeness.
tweets.nap-18000307-128: Bruix lies blockaded at Brest by twenty-one English against his seventeen French and Gravina fifteen Spaniards — humiliation for two nations by an inferior force. I have telegraphed: put to sea, chase them.
tweets.nap-18000310-129: Tell Otto in London from me: we will trade General Don for Napper Tandy and companions — or Hermann, Don and Mack for Colli, Perignon and Grouchy. Threatening our prisoners captivity shames Newton nation; prisoners answer for no government, and France never retaliates.
tweets.nap-18000405-130: No play reaches the stage without your leave, and I hold Public Instruction answerable for every immoral piece. I would also enjoy seeing the couplet about me cut from the Tableau des Sabines.
tweets.nap-18000419-131: When you read this, the army of the East will be home, leaving immortal traces in Egypt. And you, who justified my choice in giving you command — I know your satisfaction at the prospect of return.
tweets.nap-18000501-132: Print my letter whole — let the public know Egypt as I left it, against England exaggerations. Two years, great battles, and the army not diminished a fifth; no plague this year. Abandoning it is infamous.
tweets.nap-18000501-133: Your letter on Lucien wife death — she suffered long. Meanwhile we fight ice, snow and avalanches; the Bernard himself resists us, yet a third of my guns are over. In three days the whole army crosses.
tweets.nap-18000501-134: I hear Georges is back from England — take him dead or alive, with Frotté father in the Orne. Spare nothing.
tweets.nap-18000602-136: I arrive unexpectedly — no arches, no ceremonies. I think too well of myself for such nonsense; public satisfaction is my only triumph.
tweets.nap-18000621-137: Send me Paris two best virtuosos for an Italian duo at the summer festival, all expenses paid — Mesdames Billington and Grassini.
tweets.nap-18000701-138: I congratulate you on a brilliant campaign. We await Vienna answer daily — silence means war in Italy. Meanwhile Batavians and French mass beyond Mayence, and my second reserve forms.
tweets.nap-18000702-140: I am Glad Massena gave you his centre — his report of your operations delights me. I see your zeal for glory; that is the road. Count on my esteem and friendship.
tweets.nap-18000702-141: I am told Foissac-Latour skulks back in our uniform since basely yielding Mantua. He answers to public opinion for that stain — my Government is done with him.
tweets.nap-18000702-142: I Send Berthier to Spain with no title — letters from you to Urquijo, from me to the king. Tuscany for Parma Duke against Louisiana and twelve warships; rouse Spain against Portugal; survey her ports; corn for Malta from Barcelona.
tweets.nap-18000801-143: I give you Germany with the Consuls esteem and confidence — your modest refusal only confirms you. Vienna delays may break the armistice any hour; Angereau is yours, with full liberty.
tweets.nap-18000901-144: I have your letter, and thank you for its flatteries. But do not return — you would march over 100,000 corpses. Sacrifice yourself to France repose; history will remember. I feel for your family and will sweeten your retreat.
tweets.nap-18000913-145: Telegraph Strasbourg for a courier to Moreau: Vienna answers nothing, which means she wants winter. Tell their general from me that we restart hostilities — his Emperor refused St. Julien preliminaries.
tweets.nap-18001002-146: Ganteaume brings this. Peace with America, Algiers, Tunis; fair hopes everywhere. The honourably returned are esteemed — but I pity men without constancy for your noble resolve.
tweets.nap-18001101-147: I expect Dupard with two and a half millions in gold. Make Arezzo pay for storming — assaulted towns pay, no pity. Revolt anywhere gets severe examples; Italians, of all foreigners, need severity at times.
tweets.nap-18001122-148: I send you young Jérôme for His Sea apprenticeship — keep him in order, make up his lost time, exact every duty. Tell me soon he has succeeded.
tweets.nap-18001207-149: Send Cairo a company of French comedians — an idle, prosperous army needs theatre, even as politics. Forty thousand francs I do not grudge. And Talleyrand: every Egypt-bound hull carries muskets, cannon, pistols, sabres, stores.
tweets.nap-18001216-150: I want a letter to the Grand Seigneur through his ambassador here. Lay Europe before him — England alone blocks Egypt evacuation, which waits only on General peace. It is the Porte interest to resume with France.
tweets.nap-18010101-151: Your letter is here — thanks for the Nivose tidings. I followed your splendid manoeuvres with delight; you surpass yourself again. These obstinate Austrians counted on snow and ice, and never met you.
tweets.nap-18010107-152: I want Madrid told: Russia writes friendly, France and Russia will decide Prussia, cutting England from the Continent. Then France, Spain and Holland strike together — Ireland, Brazil, Surinam.
tweets.nap-18010201-153: I Send St. Cyr marching — Tell Madrid, but keep Ganteaume secret: seven ships, 4,000 men for Egypt. Shame them: two ships blockade seven of ours at Cadiz. Are these Castile conquerors?
tweets.nap-18010201-154: By secret treaty Spain gives six ships. From Portugal I demand 15 to 20 millions, four ships of the line and the frigate that blockaded me at Alexandria — a lesson to small powers. Tuscany and Elba pieces to settle with Naples.
tweets.nap-18010201-155: Your friendly letter is here — England arrogance is boundless. I mass 300 gunboats in Flanders with an army, another in Brittany for Brest. Naples and Sicily shut to the English; Bordeaux presses Portugal. Stop the northern trade with me.
tweets.nap-18010301-156: Madrid must show ten ships within the month — to catch English squadrons in the Straits or join our Mediterranean force. I demand our six vessels, Lucca for Parma against Tuscany, Havana frigates — and a Portuguese province as surety.
tweets.nap-18010312-157: Write Rome: I regret the honors paid to Cardinal Maury and condemn the prelate conduct.
tweets.nap-18010313-158: I want Houdetot at Rochefort at once, with two or three officers to draw all eyes to the expedition.
tweets.nap-18010314-159: Good news from Madrid: three Cadiz vessels, a fifty-gun ship and two Carthagena frigates for me.
tweets.nap-18010325-160: I want one of those English invasion carriages built for trial — twenty-two men, four horses, fast between points. If it answers, build more.
tweets.nap-18000505-135: I was leaving for Geneva when the telegraph sang your victory — glory, three times glory! Italy is critical, Massena locked in Genoa — I salute you affectionately.
tweets.nap-18000701-139: Tell them from me: no French Academy exists — the law dissolved it, and the Institute stands in its place. Citizens may form a literary society, unnamed, with republican rules like the Arts Lyceum.
tweets.nap-18010401-161: Forward my note to Citizen Otto: have Dutheil and Georges arrested, or shipped to America if London objects to handing them over.
tweets.nap-18010402-162: The Emperor of Russia died of apoplexy, and I grieve a prince I esteemed too much for details. His eldest son has the army and the capital oath.
tweets.nap-18010402-163: You start in Floréal for Petersburg by Berlin — two days there. Congratulate the king on Hanover for me, press my esteem on the Empress and Baden Margrave, and everywhere speak as if Egypt holds.
tweets.nap-18010424-164: The king of Tuscany leaves Madrid for Paris, Florence in forty days — stay and instal him. I hunger for Elba news. Tell me: is Abbé Bonaparte of San-Miniato alive?
tweets.nap-18010502-165: Tell Otto to laugh Hawkesbury anecdotes away: my cabinet is one, and wants only an honourable peace on balanced seas. France is not intimidated — and London mistakes Alexander if it thinks he betrays the continent.
tweets.nap-18010522-166: The prefects honored the count and Countess of Leghorn beyond measure. Tell the Seine prefect for me: no civil authority visits them.
tweets.nap-18010601-168: It is my will that Madrid man at Rome send a legate to Florence complimenting Etruria king — custom demands it.
tweets.nap-18010601-169: Toulon sick lie neglected, officers absent, convicts nursing. Put Sisters of Charity there as at Brest — I will have it so.
tweets.nap-18010614-170: Disown this magnificent treaty by extraordinary courier — it breaks its instructions, our Spanish treaty, our interests, and favors England. Occupy three provinces or keep the colonies; I call it one of my worst reverses.
tweets.nap-18010713-171: Eighty-five hours from Turin, delayed by mountains and the Empress breakfasts. When the legislature rises, retire to Monza and fit Milan palace — I want a straight walk through the state rooms to the Place du Dôme side.
tweets.nap-18010714-172: Your letter is here. Troops watch the Adriatic against Turks and English; Naples is yours once Tuscany settles. Pick up local knowledge — examine Capua and the forts, return by Ancona.
tweets.nap-18010727-173: Consalvi gave me your letter — I recognize the Gospel in it. You shall have my support while you preach peace; but Europe tears I cannot dry. Count always on your devoted son.
tweets.nap-18010810-174: Order the five departments prefects and Geneva: send me each one leading Protestant minister — no fanatics, only upright, sensible, esteemed men — quietly, to settle order, liberty and worship.
tweets.nap-18010910-175: Sound Vienna and Rome on Hompesch through Champagny and Cacault — off-hand, our support if they back him. Tell Cibou I take interest in the man and want him restored as Grand Master; 500 louis secretly, he is in need.
tweets.nap-18010917-176: Answer Otto: no Tobago. Demerara and Portugal stand settled. Time presses with the equinox — I negotiate with all Europe and will give no color of bad faith; the squadrons stay till preliminaries sign.
tweets.nap-18010919-177: Send the War minister our Batavian convention: we keep Flushing, and our Batavia commander gets secret orders to match.
tweets.nap-18011001-178: Have me a sabre model — moderate, handy, consular cut, set for the Regent and the great diamonds. I want it for Brumaire anniversary and the peace feast.
tweets.nap-18011021-180: Tell Hawkesbury through Otto: Rochefort and part of Brest sail with 12,000 men to restore St. Domingo. Spain must send plenipotentiaries to Amiens — haste, for England and I will arrange promptly.
tweets.nap-18011102-181: I have signed fourteen radiations — passport the men, hand the decrees in Paris only after they swear the Republic and renounce everything foreign.
tweets.nap-18011226-182: Tell Azara Amiens closes — Spain delayed us six weeks, and France with England cannot lose a day. We sign with or without her. Out of kindness for Charles, my intimate ally, I sign his name myself rather than shame him.
tweets.nap-18020101-183: I leave for Lyons. Bernadotte may take Guadeloupe — prosperous, cultivated, though Lacrosse offended them and 500 whites fled a mulatto chief. Three vessels, four frigates, 3,000 men sail to disarm and pacify — an agreeable mission.
tweets.nap-18020114-184: All the Eastern officers I meet confirm the reports against several generals.
tweets.nap-18020301-185: Five in the evening, no courier yet. Otto and all England letters confirm great armaments and sailing squadrons; Cornwallis has his last orders. Report to me twice daily, morning and evening — without peace signed, London must change system.
tweets.nap-18020301-186: France rejoices at your opening — Toulon, Cadiz, Flushing and Havre squadrons should have joined you. Follow your instructions to the letter: rid me of Toussaint, Christophe, Dessalines and the brigand chiefs, disarm the masses, ship the coloured fighters to the Continent.
tweets.nap-18020301-187: I want announced births and deaths in the Moniteur — courts watch it closely. Bavaria, Baden, Denmark qualify.
tweets.nap-18020320-188: The Valais must be settled — you see my view. Get me a memorandum on its ancient organisation. Helvetia, no French province, governs itself; the Valais is my affair. Warn Reding: refuse my middle way and lose everything.
tweets.nap-18020326-189: Enclosed, my Amiens treaty — Etruria and the sister republics untouched for now, to be recognized shortly. Both sides know this peace is a truce.
tweets.nap-18020401-190: The nominations stand, though I cannot yet deliver the brevets. Settle with the Legate: consecrations and institutions at once, Easter oath before me. Archbishops 15,000, bishops 10,000 — in strict secret.
tweets.nap-18020524-191: Caprara will tell you our Easter — all the Republic in splendor that moved even you. Murat warns some constitutional bishops trouble you; I named ex-bishops too, for schisms end only by reunion. Rejoice — all France holds the Concordat.
tweets.nap-18020530-192: I insist Alquier hear it plainly: Naples must respect the Pope states entire — Beneventum and Ponte Corvo back on their ancient footing.
tweets.nap-18020701-193: Write my man at Algiers: demand the reis head for bastinadoing our captain and restore the ship. Warn the Dey — listeners to France enemies are ruined; none insults me unpunished. Speak imperiously, rupture or not.
tweets.nap-18020727-194: Magnificent Dey — my adjutant demands reparation for insults to my flag, and your 200,000 piastres demand disgusts me. I never paid anyone; thank God, I lay the law on all my enemies. I crushed the Mamelukes for demanding money after insulting my flag.
tweets.nap-18020828-195: I have read your letter with full attention. I approve your naming one of my subjects Grand Master of Malta. It pains me you see no Concordat with Italy — consider my cardinals: Paris, Lyons, Troyes, Autun. Old Paris is sound at ninety-three; young Lyons shows promise.
tweets.nap-18021031-196: I rode Rouen heights at 8 — the beloved Archbishop said mass but no Holy water, no prayer for me. We take revenge tomorrow, all Saints day. Notary Petit to the Temple at once; the eight curés under guard to Italy.
tweets.nap-18021126-197: All I have read of your work strikes me as perfectly clear. I long to give it weeks of study, and I rue the press of affairs that steals me from the sciences. I accept your dedication gladly; let posterity remember my esteem and friendship for its author.
tweets.nap-18021127-198: Your letter is here — condolences on Parma. France had the right to take your states two years ago, yet I forbore for love of you. But I cannot break my own signed treaty; Europe would cry shame to see Ferdinand stripped and Sardinia king waiting.
tweets.nap-18010522-167: Your Bordeaux commissary let couplets for the Tuscan king — called Louis! — invite sedition. See that no verse is read or sung in any theatre or square.
tweets.nap-18011010-179: The peace with England, Portugal, Russia, and the Ottoman Porte having been signed, I hasten to inform your Holiness of this fact, knowing the interest you take in the happiness and tranquillity of nations.
tweets.nap-18030115-199: The new Captain-General reaches an India ruled by rivals — give them no alarm. Confine yourself to indispensable business, and within six months send me the full picture: peoples, princes, and their temper under the English yoke.
tweets.nap-18030301-200: You go to Russia with my letter. Speak of how Paris esteems Russians, talk philosophy not trifles with the Emperor. If Constantine appears, tell him I regret he missed Paris. If England comes up, say France longs to measure swords with her.
tweets.nap-18030301-201: I Order Monnet to Flushing with full authority, no Dutch interference — the place is Franco-Dutch common ground, and everything goes in France name. Treat their People and officers well, and talk to them often.
tweets.nap-18030501-202: Your Malmaison letter is here. Be cold, haughty, even proud with Whitworth: if his note says ultimatum, tell him that word means war, and that superiors do not negotiate with inferiors so. If it lacks the word, make him insert it — we must know where we stand.
tweets.nap-18030510-203: Your letters please me, but war with England rekindles and I have done all to spare the world. Unite every Power for Malta independence — I count on the sentiments you have expressed.
tweets.nap-18030610-204: I beg you will hand 100,000 francs to Colonel Sebastiani for secret expenses; 25,000 francs to M. Chatillon; 30,000 to the Bishop of Orleans, and 25,000 to the Prefect of the Loire-Inferieure.
tweets.nap-18030619-205: My orders go to Mortier for the Hanover army: England refused the Prairial convention, so capitulate — defile with honours, disarm, dismount, march prisoner to France. Warn Laforest in Berlin first, for his troops must move within days of the order.
tweets.nap-18030701-206: I approve your Hanover Convention. Be inflexible — no English goods or couriers through. It will ruin English houses. Send me heavy cavalry horses, and disarm the country.
tweets.nap-18030801-209: I shall reach St. Cloud unannounced, perhaps by night, and receive the authorities next day. I feel the Tribunate good will all the same.
tweets.nap-18030810-211: Spain matters more than subsidies or treaties to me: two of our ships cut out at Algeciras without redress; four warships left bare at Corunna before the enemy like Barbary prizes; 100,000 militia raised, plainly not for British fleets.
tweets.nap-18030810-212: Send Laforest Russia latest note to show Haugwitz its absurdity. England gets from me only Amiens — nothing in the Mediterranean. I evacuate Holland and Switzerland; Otranto, Tarentum and Hanover go when Malta does.
tweets.nap-18030901-214: Write our Aleppo agent: does the Wahhabi chief protect Frenchmen crossing his lands to Syria and Egypt from pillage as friends? Get me his force and position. And tell Rousseau to open Persia and write oftener; send Brune to learn who commands at Constantinople.
tweets.nap-18030902-215: Withdraw that Cadzand demi-brigade — the men will sicken. If England tries Walcheren there is time. Health first: sickly quarters melt armies to nothing, and Walcheren already costs us dear.
tweets.nap-18031001-216: I am informed. Citizen minister, that Madame de Stael has arrived at Maffiers. Let her be informed through one of her friends, without making a scandal, that if she still lingers, the gendarmes escort her to the frontier.
tweets.nap-18031010-217: I was shocked to hear the Spanish ambassador dispute precedence with France minister at Florence. Tell me if Clarke has written — I will not suffer this ridiculous pretension on any pretext.
tweets.nap-18031101-218: It is time you proposed the Irish battalions. Hand me a roll of the Irish here counting on the expedition, to settle rank and business.
tweets.nap-18031101-219: I understand your note perfectly. Settle the pending Bank-Treasury transactions — but never borrow from the Bank on any account. Tell Lebrun to strengthen the Bank confidence; I will aid it always.
tweets.nap-18031101-220: I beg you will have a song written for the invasion of England to the Chant du départ tune — more songs, more tunes. Pick the comedies fit for Paris theatres and especially the Boulogne and Bruges camps where the army lies.
tweets.nap-18031112-221: Citizen general — I have your letter, and order hoods for every man of the Ireland expedition under you. Spain and Portugal are settled.
tweets.nap-18031117-222: Ney affair deserves no attention. But boats without men intrigue me — some Swiss mountaineer scheme promising wonders is hardly reasonable. Now Prussia: evacuation of Hanover? Preponderance in Germany?
tweets.nap-18031201-223: Put Madame Bourmont to the question for me about her foreign visitor of last month. Let her understand the examination matters, and tell the whole truth plainly.
tweets.nap-18031201-224: Your Somme letter is here, with the prince de Galles visit report. Fit her out as you propose for the guard sailors, with three more ships for my followers — and a howitzer aboard if she carries it easily.
tweets.nap-18031201-225: I know everything: the Bertins Take English gold, proved by their articles tone. This is my last warning of displeasure — next they learn it by suppression. Only journals that rouse the nation against England and steel it for war will exist.
tweets.nap-18031212-226: Send Madrid an extraordinary courier: arrest Coucy and hand him to Bayonne gendarmes. His incendiary preachings shake the public peace, English-paid — I cannot believe His Catholic majesty will shield him. Tell Beurnonville: no empty formality.
tweets.nap-18040104-227: Send for Emmet, Thomson, and the other Irish chiefs, and let them know that I have read the inclosed memorial with the greatest attention.
tweets.nap-18040113-228: Tascher, officer of my Guard — start tomorrow for Rome, lodge with Cardinal Fesch, and deliver my letter into the Pope hands. Stay till His Holiness answers, eight or ten days in the city.
tweets.nap-18030801-210: The Irish chiefs in Paris need secret talks — offer 25,000 men, 40,000 muskets with guns and powder, and my pledge of no separate peace with England before a free Ireland is proclaimed. Twenty thousand of them with our landing force.
tweets.nap-18040113-229: I am Glad Vernegues is arrested — send him by Rimini under escort to Paris. Ignore Russian intercessions; Petersburg never approved them. Bribed intriguers meddle where they should not — pack him off at once.
tweets.nap-18040124-230: Drake letters matter most. Feed his bulletin this: the Committee delights in my Boulogne embarkation, but now sees costly feints — launches convertible to merchantmen — and a commander too secure to risk masses of troops. Ireland is the real blow.
tweets.nap-18040302-231: Nelson offers Latouche a prisoner exchange — tell me your answer. But no exchange: England king always appends impossible conditions. No flags of truce at Toulon.
tweets.nap-18040310-232: My orders tonight: Ordener for Strasbourg under a false name — to Ettenheim, to seize Enghien, Dumouriez and their English colonel. Caulaincourt takes 200 dragoons to Offenburg for the Reich woman and the other English agents.
tweets.nap-18040310-233: I am sending Enghien to Vincennes — everything prepared, everything secret, travelling as Plessis. The commandant himself must not know his prisoner name.
tweets.nap-18040312-234: I want you among the soldiers in detail — inspect them man by man, eight hours at a stretch. Hear complaints, check arms, want for nothing. Long inspections teach endurance and prove the chief shares the hardship.
tweets.nap-18040401-235: It pains me you scorn Rome people and customs, eyes forever on Paris. Amid vast affairs I still speak: love your husband and his house, live Roman, shun bad counsel — or count on no support from me, Paris least of all.
tweets.nap-18040414-237: The councils and great bodies demand an end to Bourbon hopes — sound the army on making it hereditary. The nation made me great and powerful; I want nothing more, only her interest. My brother Joseph, major of the Revolution, burns to soldier.
tweets.nap-18040510-238: Steube of Württemberg is an ignorant fool — hint delicately he should be recalled; it would please me. Write Lannes at Lisbon, tell Souza here: the Portuguese minister at Berlin, our bitter enemy, must go.
tweets.nap-18040530-239: I want Hawkesbury note circulated to every court but Russia, Sweden, Denmark and the Porte: France notes the insults with sovereign contempt — But England proclaimed principles subvert all Europe order, and that deserves answering.
tweets.nap-18040610-240: But for Moreau miserable trial I would be in the camps. Give the Cardinal Archbishop my fourteen Tournay silver vases for Paris church.
tweets.nap-18040721-241: Four days in the saddle and my health holds. Maret says you leave Monday — easy stages to the waters. Last night gale drove a gunboat ashore; we saved all, amid alarm guns and burning coasts.
tweets.nap-18040730-242: On Enghien: I take it you instructed my man in America on his conduct there. See that he follows it.
tweets.nap-18040801-243: My health is restored — I require you to live long years yet. I am satisfied with all I have seen. Paris exaggerates our gale losses; tell our agents the army stands strong and I pass whole days drilling it.
tweets.nap-18040801-244: Dessalines makes a legion of honour, I hear — verify whether some journalist beard pranks us.
tweets.nap-18040801-245: My answer to Gravina: Wright was caught landing Jean Marie and two cutthroats. Three times he put brigands ashore to murder France chief magistrate — with Hawkesbury 40,000 behind him. Gallant officers would never so stain their flag.
tweets.nap-18040810-246: Mention Petersburg vileness wherever useful — an Emperor who rewards his father murderer, an ambassador false to the bone. They must stop taking me for a dupe; Talleyrand has orders for a note on Russia.
tweets.nap-18040810-247: I find in every regiment a hundred lame, sickly conscripts — dead loss rotting in depots, wearing uniforms, costing money. And substitutes desert the moment they are paid.
tweets.nap-18040814-248: Your letter pleased me — your mother memory and you interest me always. I shall help your brother when I can. But you live near Lyons and never came to see me while I was there — I reproach you for it.
tweets.nap-18040814-249: Vienna needs my recognition, not I hers — Russia and Prussia will smart. I yield nothing to Germany Emperor; I recognize him as Austria Emperor only if he recognizes me first.
tweets.nap-18040824-250: Give Oubril his note — passports if he wants them, but he leaves Paris only when my man crosses into Russia. Markoff openly fondled émigrés in English pay, and Russia mourns a condemned conspirator.
tweets.nap-18040830-251: Sir, my Brother — on recognising my house as imperial, Austria wished the same for hers. This lets me tell you how much more I value Prussia conduct, and that through Arberg I pledge myself to your crown splendour.
tweets.nap-18040901-253: I want you ready to carry a thousand men and five hundred horses to Ireland -- fatal to our enemies.
tweets.nap-18040901-254: Your kind letter moves me — congratulations on the Imperial house of Austria. Long reign and lasting peace between us; your family happiness is never foreign to my welfare. My harmony and esteem are constant.
tweets.nap-18040910-255: Religion return has remade my people morals — come crown its work yourself. Anoint and crown the first French Emperor; your hand gives the lustre, and heaven blessing falls on us all.
tweets.nap-18040914-256: Your commissioners coin money from gaming tables everywhere. Let the towns keep it — I grant Bordeaux 200,000 francs for a bridge or canal.
tweets.nap-18041001-257: I reach Treves as you reach St. Cloud. Give T... No private audience, receive B... In public — and sign no marriage contract before I do.
tweets.nap-18041110-258: Sardinia chateau furniture is mine. I released Rumbold the hour your letter touched me — your peace is part of my happiness. My minister will lay England bare to your ambassador: no treaties, no nations, only plots.
tweets.nap-18041210-259: I write in displeasure: my invitations say dinner, yet the word supper appears. In my palace as elsewhere, the laws are obeyed.
tweets.nap-18050130-260: Most excellent Sultan, my perfect friend — if 15,000 Russians at Corfu do not threaten me, are you blind? Favoured by Greeks, they will attack your capital one day, and your empire and dynasty sink into oblivion with you.
tweets.nap-18050201-261: Junot carries this — I charge him to tell you of my care for Portugal and my hope we march together toward the seas balance, against England abuses and insults to neutrals. Your assurances guarantee we shall hurt her most.
tweets.nap-18050310-262: I want school classics priced by the page — parents bleed. Move the useless stone pillars where footways need them.
tweets.nap-18050401-263: Dominica is ours; my Toulon squadron sailed with Lauriston, and Decaen arms the Mahrattas in India. But Walcheren is absurd — I shall always repent Monnet sickly losses. Keep no Frenchmen there.
tweets.nap-18050410-264: Tell Moustier for me: I cannot conceive fearing 30,000 Russians with Prussia 300,000 behind her — her guns, horse and officers are worth thirty times Russia.
tweets.nap-18050421-265: I forward you a report concerning Creusot. It is essential to keep up this establishment. No purchase; but give fixed orders as their foundation, and let them stand.
tweets.nap-18050502-266: Elba owes me 500,000 francs for four years, and paid 80,000 then 65,000. Enforce payment at once — the isle is open.
tweets.nap-18050506-267: Brother-in-law — this Anglo-Russian alliance talk is English-spread nonsense, utterly false, to wriggle from their straits. I know the truth, but the country alarms easily.
tweets.nap-18050529-268: I hear Genoa would join us — England alone objects. As for Fouché Anglo-Russian treaty: false, a failed English ruse. Though Pitt proclaim it in Parliament, call it untrue.
tweets.nap-18050601-269: Propose Vienna an exchange of honours — I have Prussian, Bavarian and Portuguese cordons, and see no reason to except Austria, which would only signal coldness.
tweets.nap-18050602-270: Keep sending me the Seleucia archbishop Rome-to-Dresden letters — my decipherers read them easy.
tweets.nap-18050720-271: I want everything embarked — guns, powder, stores — within twenty-four hours. Ney lands first with a dashing vanguard; four beaches, no instant lost. Tell the marshals.
tweets.nap-18050724-272: Spain gives me six Golden Fleeces — one is yours. Feed the Moniteur calming stories; my squadrons bring excellent news. Get two cardinals hats, and give Rayane and Caselli the Grand Eagle. Answer me on Jerome marriage.
tweets.nap-18050727-273: End the legislature by decree — it shall not meet under my reign. I thought too well of Italians; a third voted down a plain finance bill. No messages, no honours — publish my displeasure. They are not children, and there is malice in them.
tweets.nap-18050902-278: Here are my German allies — Bavaria, Baden, Württemberg, Hesse-Darmstadt, all with strong corps. Print in the Gazettes that I am with the army and Austria flies in fear and disorder.
tweets.nap-18050910-279: Boulogne holds nothing now but its coast guard — in days we see whether Vienna or I laugh last.
tweets.nap-18050910-280: Tell priest Robert of Bourges I am displeased with his recent sermon.
tweets.nap-18050910-281: My good Austrian brother came to Memmingen, counciled, and went home. God keep his army still a week — or better, marching on the Rhine. Woe to them if I gain a march or two.
tweets.nap-18050914-282: They hold the Black Forest passes — God keep them there. My only fear is frightening them off. Great things happen within a fortnight.
tweets.nap-18051001-283: Still well, bound for Stuttgart as the manoeuvres open — Württemberg and Baden have joined me, position good, and I love you. Last night Don Juan in German — the Paris opera itself, and very good.
tweets.nap-18051002-284: Your letter is here. We always crossed Baireuth and Anspach, as I promised — soon I stand in central Germany. With God help Munich restored, your house fixed beyond driving out.
tweets.nap-18051002-285: A week wet to the skin has tired me, but rest restores. My design is done — the Austrian army destroyed by marching: 60,000 prisoners, 120 guns, 90 colours, 30 generals, at 1,500 of ours. Now for the Russians; they are lost. Adieu, love.
tweets.nap-18051101-286: Thank the council for me. We near Vienna, brushing the Russians — they retire faster than we march, hated for plunder and fire. The country suffers them no longer.
tweets.nap-18051102-287: I lay my War contribution on Moravia and occupied Austria — this sum rewards the army.
tweets.nap-18051202-293: Your letter is here. The Emperor and Charles both write — I meet the archduke three leagues from Vienna. I congratulated peace but concede nothing; no politics with Charles, two hours: one dining, one soldiering.
tweets.nap-18051214-294: The German Emperor had his interview — two to four, wanting peace on the spot, appealing to my feelings. I held firm — not hard. He has his armistice. Tell Haugwitz to wait at Vienna: victory hardens my terms, especially for negotiators sent the day of battle.
tweets.nap-18051214-295: From this campaign opening, pastorals in every see justifying this new war, and calling upon the conscripts to join my corps.
tweets.nap-18051225-296: Read Barbe-Marbois letter, seal it, deliver it. Incapacity or treason — the coalition never had a better ally. I suspend judgment till Paris, but he has surely betrayed me. One escape: restore the missing bonds. Talk finance, not Cambacérès.
tweets.nap-18060102-302: Your Placentia bulletin displeased me, but your measures satisfy me — I blame words and praise zeal. Marbois loses his portfolio; impossible deeds, though I still call him honest, led by scamps.
tweets.nap-18060112-303: You will be near Rome soon; Dumas is sent. After rest you will hold 40,000 men in three corps — Massena strongest, St. Cyr, Regnier 6,000 reserve. Befriend cold Regnier; he plans best. Make each believe your confidence.
tweets.nap-18060124-304: Occupy Frankfort with a division — no contributions yet. Only united with your whole corps, demand its 4,000,000 francs for the Grand army chest.
tweets.nap-18060130-305: Your letters are here — Munich, I presume. Till Haugwitz shows, keep my army ready for war, ready to move at the speed of thought.
tweets.nap-18060202-313: My sister — let your court wear only silks and cambric, never cottons or muslins, for French industry sake.
tweets.nap-18060202-314: Your letter is here — I compliment you on fallen Naples. Every Neapolitan officer in Paris and my Italy goes to you.
tweets.nap-18060214-315: Berthier carries my Anspach orders — Prussia broke Vienna treaty and it is null. She holds Hanover yet yields neither Cleves nor Anspach. I want her driven north.
tweets.nap-18060301-316: I want three countries to round out Murat: Essen and Werden abbeys, Lamark, Witgenstein — two Prussia, the third unknown. Find what Prussia takes in exchange.
tweets.nap-18060301-317: Ver Huell convinced me in one evening: Holland has no executive and needs one — I give her Prince Louis. Religions respected, constitution kept, only a king for a pensioner. Loo castle funds his splendour; Amsterdam within twenty days.
tweets.nap-18060307-318: Your Naples proclamations promise no contributions — good. The new English government seems better principled than the last, if Mr. — letter judges true.
tweets.nap-18060402-319: Forward Lucca claim: Etruria queen must cede, compensated from the Pope or Naples rents. I leave Lacepede Chambord decree unsigned — but send repair money for a hundred pupils.
